data.narrative:
44.01 is a Series A–stage climate and energy company that has raised $37M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes one public comparable (Linacor Anz) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient depth at the same stage and valuation tier to support a reliable peer-median approach; only one triangulation method is defensible here.

The Stage-Progression method applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $37M total raised proxy, reflecting typical Series A to subsequent-stage advancement dynamics. This yields an implied valuation of $74M. A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-band comparables within the Climate & Energy sector at matching stages and valuations; applying broader sector medians would introduce excessive noise.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $63M (low) to $85M (high), with a median of $74M. This range reflects reliance on a single method and should be weighted accordingly. Key uncertainties include capital intensity and burn profile relative to the sector, the company's stage-specific milestones (product, revenue, partnerships), and whether the 2.0x multiplier adequately reflects 44.01's risk profile relative to better-capitalized peers. Additional data on revenue, unit economics, or technology maturity would strengthen conviction in this range.
